_comment: Batch lifecycle shapes as DATA (40-06). Two independent shapes live here: the snapshot MANIFEST.json that build writes and verify re-checks, and the owner PASS artifact that a barrier consumes. FL-02 (R8): the pass shape constrains VALUES and identities, not merely key presence -- a verdict of PASS whose mechanical fields recorded failures is a schema violation, reported by name.
_comment_values: FL-02.1/FL-02.4 -- the mechanical fields carry enums with a designated SUCCESS value. state_shape must be PASS, tree_diff_sha_match must be boolean true, trace_validation must not be fail. A run failing any of these cannot count toward a PASS verdict.
_comment_identity: FL-02.2 -- (diff, run_index) is the run identity and must be unique across runs.
_comment_artifacts: FL-02.3 -- each run carries the two captured artifacts and check_pass_artifact asserts both EXIST relative to the artifact's own directory. A run without them is not scoreable.
_comment_adjudication: adjudication defaults to pending-assistant: the owner records mechanical facts and the assistant adjudicates SITE/AXIS/BAND afterwards (40-09). A barrier refuses an artifact still carrying pending-assistant, so the handoff cannot be skipped.
_comment_runs: D-06: each per-batch live check is 2 diffs x1 -- one should-catch and one should-quiet.
